words.word: wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar

occurrences.text: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar, and as waters that fail?
words: wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar

occurrences.text: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth–gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.
